Article Title: Rahul Gandhi slams BJP over NEET protest crackdown, says students were forced to apologise
Article Text:
Rahul Gandhi slams BJP over NEET crackdown

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Standing with a group of youngsters who faced police action during the NEET protests , Congress leader Rahul Gandhi Wednesday said the ruling party is sending goons to the homes of students and forcing them to apologise, after which those apologies are being accepted by the PM.“There is no question of the youngsters apologising… I am very proud of them and what thousands of them did… They defended the Constitution and protected the idea of India and India’s future,” Rahul said.The Congress leader held a “freewheeling” discussion at his residence with a group of youngsters who participated in the protests at Jantar Mantar and other parts of the country. It included Riya Ahir whose photo went viral after she stood in front of a police van in Mumbai and Muskan Sharma who was victim of a cop “jabbing a baton into her buttocks” at Jantar Mantar on July 20. Farah Naaz alleged that in police detention, she faced communal barbs with a cop even calling her “anti-national”. Muskan said she was being assumed to be a Muslim which makes an Indian a “fair game”, even clarifying that she is a Hindu. Nutan Toppo said a pellet gun was fired at her.The leader of opposition’s decision to meet the youngsters to 10, Janpath, for a chat further upped the ante in the “BJP vs opposition” confrontation that has jammed the ongoing monsoon session of parliament.Continuing its aggression, a large contingent of opposition MPs marched inside the Parliament complex to protest the “absence of Amit Shah from parliament” and “Ayodhya donation scam”. The group included Mallikarjun Kharge, Rahul Gandhi, Dimple Yadav, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, Dharmendra Yadav, Supriya Sule, NK Premachandran, Sagarika Ghose, Amar Singh, Chowdry Mohd Ramzan, John Brittas, Sandosh Kumar, Naseer Hussain, K Radhakrishnan.Rahul held a placard with a face riddled with pellet gun injuries and a question “who gave the order?” The members also sought statehood for J&K.Addressing the media with the youngsters, Rahul said, “They are so young and standing before the media. But the prime minister and the home minister have no courage to stand before the press."He attacked home minister Amit Shah by saying that he is responsible for the crackdown on youngsters but “he does not have the decency to come to the Parliament, and the courage to comment on what happened.”Rahul took a jibe at PM Narendra Modi for saying that he has forgiven the students.
Article Summary: The Congress leader held a “freewheeling’ discussion at his residence with a group of youngsters who participated in the protests at Jantar Mantar and other parts of the country. The group included Riya Ahir whose photo went viral after she stood in front of a police van in Mumbai and Muskan Sharma who was victim of a cop “jabbing a baton into her buttocks”

Article Title: Bring young faces: Abhijeet Dipke on RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s youth outreach
Article Text:
Abhijeet Dipke welcomed the RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's planned youth interaction





CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGAR: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke on Tuesday welcomed RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat ’s proposed interaction with Gen Z and Alpha students from 100 cities in Mumbai on Aug 6, but said the organisation should bring “educated” young leaders to the forefront instead of relying solely on senior leadership.“It is a good thing that they have realised the need to connect with the youth, even if a little late. This is a positive step. But it would be more effective if young people themselves spoke to the youth. Bringing educated young faces to the forefront will help address many challenges. There is nothing wrong with senior leaders speaking, but giving space to new and educated faces would be better,” he said.Responding to alleged remarks from RSS circles describing the recent youth movement led by CJP at Jantar Mantar as “anti-national” and “anti-constitutional”, Dipke said, “Those who assassinated Mahatma Gandhi and opposed Bharat Ratna Dr B R Ambedkar must not preach about the Indian Constitution.”Dipke also extended support to the agitation against E20 fuel being spearheaded by the Aam Aadmi Party and others. “We are getting requests that CJP should comment on the issue of fuel blending. It has become a big issue as vehicle engines are getting damaged and mileage is declining,” he said.On reports of friction between the BJP and Shiv Sena after Sena functionaries met him following the Jantar Mantar agitation, Dipke questioned the BJP’s reaction.“Why is the BJP afraid of a 30-year-old person like me? You have ED and CBI with you,” he said.Dismissing a complaint lodged against him by social media influencer Faizan Ansari with Delhi Police over an alleged assault in Maharashtra, Dipke termed it a publicity stunt. “I don’t know who he is. He even claims to have been attacked in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar when I was not in the town,” he said.Dipke said a two-day CJP strategy meeting beginning in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on Wednesday would focus on the party’s expansion across the country.
Article Summary: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke welcomed RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat’s proposed interaction with Gen Z and Alpha students from 100 cities in Mumbai on Aug 6. Dipke also extended support to the agitation against E20 fuel being spearheaded by the Aam Aadmi Party and others.

Article Title: Resident doctor among eight held in Solapur fake disability certificate racket
Article Text:
Police have arrested the doctor along with three alleged agents, two clerks and two beneficiaries

Kolhapur:





The Solapur city police have unearthed an alleged fake disability certificate racket operating from the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj District Civil Hospital and arrested eight people, including a resident medical officer, for allegedly issuing fraudulent documents used to secure or retain govt jobs.Among those arrested is Dr Satish Kanake, a 31-year-old resident medical officer, who was taken into custody on Monday night. A court has remanded him in police custody till Aug 7. The case was registered following a complaint lodged by dean Rutwik Devidas Jaykar on July 4.Police commissioner M Rajkumar said, “A man identified as Rajesh Bhausaheb Jadhav was issued a disability certificate to continue in his govt job. Following a complaint, an investigation found that he had obtained the certificate using a fake Aadhaar card. While the Aadhaar showed a Solapur address, he was actually a resident of Ahilyanagar.”Police have arrested the doctor along with three alleged agents, two clerks and two beneficiaries. The accused have been booked under sections 318(4), 337(3), 338, 340, 233, 235 and 2(3) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.According to the commissioner, scrutiny of certificates issued since Jan 2025 revealed suspicious irregularities. “Since Jan 2025, 3,714 divyang certificates were issued by the hospital. Of them, we have found that eight were suspiciously issued on fake documents and without verification by specialist doctors,” Rajkumar added.The arrested accused have been identified as Dr Satish Kanake, Rajesh Jadhav, Mahesh Bargaje, Rajesh Shavan, Vijay Garje, Arun Shimpi, Wasim Shaukat Khan and Sagar Rajput.The police said Rajput and Khan, both clerks at the hospital, were arrested on July 29. Dean Jaykar has initiated proceedings for their suspension, as govt rules mandate suspension of employees who remain in police custody for more than two days.The police said Bargaje, Garje and Shavan allegedly worked as agents from Ahilyanagar and have faced similar criminal cases in the past. The probe has also revealed manipulation of the certificate issuance process. To obtain a disability certificate, applicants must undergo both online and physical verification. An OTP required for online approval is sent to the dean’s mobile phone. The police alleged that Dr Kanake accessed the OTP and repeatedly used it to generate fake certificates.According to preliminary investigations, applicants were allegedly charged between Rs 3 lakh and Rs 5 lakh to obtain the certificates.
Article Summary: Dr Satish Kanake, a 31-year-old resident medical officer, was taken into custody on Monday night. The case was registered following a complaint lodged by dean Rutwik Devidas Jaykar on July 4. The police alleged that Dr Kanake accessed the OTP and repeatedly used it to generate fake certificates.

Article Title: NCP workers protest Congress over ‘Gungi Gudiya’ barb at Sunetra Pawar
Article Text:
The agitation began outside the district collectorate before the party workers marched to the Congress city office on Mahatma Gandhi Road

Nashik

:





NCP workers on Wednesday staged a protest against Congress over the “Gungi Gudiya” barb at deputy chief minister Sunetra Pawar, demanding an apology.The agitation began outside the district collectorate before the party workers marched to the Congress city office on Mahatma Gandhi Road , raising slogans against Congress MP Rahul Gandhi and party’s Maharashtra unit president Harshwardhan Sapkal. Congress workers responded with counter-slogans in support of their politicians.The standoff between workers of the rival parties briefly disrupted traffic on Mahatma Gandhi Road. To avoid any clash, police put barricades and deployed additional senior officers and personnel from the Sarkarwada and Bhadrakali police stations.The protest was led by NCP politicians, including MLA Saroj Ahire and district party president Vishnupant Mhaisdhune, city president Ranjan Thackeray. Addressing the gathering, Ahire described the remark against Pawar as offensive and disrespectful, and demanded a public apology from Sapkal. She said women across Maharashtra stood firmly behind the deputy chief minister.Responding to the protest, Nashik city Congress president Nilesh (Bablu) Khaire said NCP workers should focus on pressing civic issues, including pothole-ridden roads and related accidents, rather than staging demonstrations outside the Congress office.
Article Summary: NCP workers staged a protest against Congress over the ‘Gungi Gudiya’ barb at deputy chief minister Sunetra Pawar. Police put barricades and deployed additional senior officers and personnel from the Sarkarwada and Bhadrakali police stations.

Article Title: Two more registration officials suspended in Palani mutt land scam
Article Text:
file picture

Madurai:





The registration department has suspended two more officials in connection with the fraudulent registration of 1.4 acres of land worth Rs 100 crore belonging to Arulmigu Dhandapani Swamigal Madam in Palani, Dindigul district.Sub-registrar Balachandar and office assistant Sivasankari were placed under suspension on Monday. Balachandar had initiated the registration process for the disputed property on July 3, while Sivasankari was working at the Palani sub-registrar’s office.Meanwhile, the anticipatory bail petitions filed by sub-registrar Justin Manikandan Subramanian and alleged document writer Jeyaprakash, both apprehending arrest by the CB-CID, came up for hearing before the Madras high court on Tuesday.After hearing submissions from the petitioners and the state, Justice K Rajasekar reserved orders till Wednesday.The high court had earlier granted interim anticipatory bail to Justin Manikandan Subramanian on July 10 and directed him to appear before CB-CID officials between July 27 and Aug 3 and cooperate with the investigation.On July 29, CB-CID arrested four persons — D Murugadas of Villupuram, who allegedly sold the land; K Vellathurai of Tirupur and D Sethupathi, who allegedly purchased it; and S Anwardeen of Palani, who allegedly facilitated the transaction.The case relates to the alleged fraudulent registration of the mutt land through fabricated records. Based on a complaint lodged by Muruganandam, superintendent of the Palani temple lands division, Palani Adivaram police initially registered the case before it was transferred to the CB-CID.
Article Summary: The registration department has suspended two more officials in connection with the fraudulent registration of 1.4 acres of land worth Rs 100 crore in Palani, Dindigul district. Sub-registrar Balachandar and office assistant Sivasankari were placed under suspension on Monday.

Article Title: Truck driver dies in road accident near Salem
Article Text: SALEM: A driver died in an accident involving a truck, a pickup van and a bus near Mecheri in Salem district on Wednesday. More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident.According to the Mecheri police, a TNSTC bus carrying 51 passengers was heading to Karur from Mettur when a speeding pickup van attempted to overtake it. “The pickup van collided head-on with a truck coming from the opposite direction,” said an officer at the Mecheri police station. The truck grazed the bus, shattering its windows and injuring more than 10 passengers seated near the windows.Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. The injured were rushed to govt hospitals in Mettur and Omalur.Fire service personnel, assisted by Mecheri police and residents, worked to move the damaged truck and pickup van to the roadside. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.The Mecheri police registered a case.
Article Summary: More than 10 bus passengers suffered injuries in the accident. Truck driver C Penumoola Revanthra, 53 of Guntur in Andhra Pradesh died on the spot. Traffic on the Mettur–Salem highway was disrupted for an hour.

Article Title: Sabarimala Milma ghee ‘misappropriation’: HC directs vigilance to appoint M J Sojan as probe team head
Article Text:
Representational image

Kochi:





The high court has directed the vigilance director to appoint vigilance and anti-corruption bureau Ernakulam special cell superintendent of police M J Sojan as the head of the special team probing the alleged misappropriation of ghee supplied by Milma to the Sabarimala Sannidhanam during the 2025-26 pilgrimage season.During the hearing on Wednesday, the state govt informed the court that the vigilance director had, in compliance with its earlier order, constituted a special team to investigate the alleged misappropriation. The team comprises vigilance deputy superintendent of police C S Hari and inspectors Saji Shankar A S, Sreejith S, Kiran T R and Ratheendra Kumar R S.The govt also submitted a panel of three vigilance SPs — J Mahesh, M J Sojan and R Binu — for appointment as the head of the team, from which the court selected Sojan.The bench of Justices V Raja Vijayaraghavan and K V Jayakumar issued the direction after noting that Sojan is already investigating the alleged misappropriation of the proceeds from ‘aadiya sishtam ghee’ at Sabarimala. The court observed that it would be appropriate for the same officer to head the investigation in the present matter as well.Previously, the court had ordered a vigilance probe into the allegations while considering a report submitted by the Sabarimala special commissioner regarding the alleged misappropriation of ghee procured from Milma for the Sabarimala temple.It had observed that Travancore Devaswom Board allegedly caused a loss of Rs 2.27 crore by bypassing the ongoing tender process and awarding the contract for the supply of ghee for the preparation of aravana prasadam to Milma instead of a Tamil Nadu-based private dairy that had emerged as the lowest bidder. The court had also directed the vigilance director to constitute a special investigation team and submit a progress report within one month.While considering the matter on Wednesday, the court orally observed that the investigation would cover the award of the contract to Milma after the ongoing tender process was bypassed. Under the tender, a Tamil Nadu-based private dairy had quoted Rs 369 per litre, whereas the contract was awarded to Milma at Rs 510 per litre. The court further observed that, despite the Sabarimala special commissioner objecting to the procurement of ghee at the higher rate, the board ignored the objection and awarded the contract to Milma.
Article Summary: The high court has directed the vigilance director to appoint vigilance and anti-corruption bureau Ernakulam special cell superintendent of police M J Sojan as the head of the special team. The court observed that it would be appropriate for the same officer to head the investigation in the present matter as well.
